newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Acesita Q1 net vs loss.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Acesita Q1 net vs loss.

text.p: Brazilian steelmaker Acesita issued the following statement on its first quarter results.
Net oper profit 12.438 million loss 28.157 million

NOTE: Figures in Brazilian reais, not adjusted for inflation. The company said in a statement its first quarter earnings, adjusted for inflation, were 23.1 million reais, against a net loss of 24.6 million reais in the same period of 1996.
The first quarter earnings were mostly due to improved gross margins, the steelmaker said in the statement.
It also said it sold 115,847 tonnes of steel, worth gross revenues of 151.1 million reais.
Stainless steel accounted for 57 percent of the company's revenues, totalling 31,690 tonnes in 1997, down from 32.267 tonnes in the same period of last year.
Acesita also said it invested $43.6 million, of which $28.1 million in expanding its stainless steel production.
